ig_caption:
Mon, Nov 23: 4,562 deer reported statewide (2,563 antlered, 1,999 antlerless). Season total: 208,370.

The fastest-growing counties Monday were all in the Upper Peninsula: Alger rose 8% (342 to 371 deer), Gogebic 6% and Marquette 5%, as statewide new reports slipped to 4,562, the lowest since Nov 14.

Full county-by-county report: https://claude.ai/artifact/QSxie3gQQgNNuQDU3D7yTe
